software.name: Typst compiler used for pinned PDFs

mathematics.assertion_tested: The final 13-slide presentation and 28-page report are numerically consistent with the pinned completed small-batch AdamW campaign records over the stated finite grids and promoted seed sets; source, extract, derived-data, and figure hashes authenticate the exact evidence package.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE 754 binary64 for loss means, sample standard deviations, moment half-lives, and exp(loss-gap) perplexity ratios; exact integer counts, recipe/seed sets, full input bytes, and SHA-256 identities.
mathematics.conventions: Lower mean final full-validation cross-entropy is better. Means use seeds 42–44; SD uses n-1=2; replication-only means use 43–44 without reselection. Half-life is -ln(2)/ln(beta) updates, scaled by global_batch*512 for global targets and divided by four for decentralized per-worker targets. Clipping rate divides worker exceedance counts by four times updates for decentralized training. Historical synchronous batch-128 clipping is unavailable, not zero.
inputs: 40 clipped, 20 no-clipping, and 4 synchronous three-seed replicated recipes
480 matched clipping pairs and 13 matched three-seed recipes
Frozen selections and 12 imported observations: 8 primary and 4 supplemental
261 pinned original source artifacts, 42 bundled extracts, 10 derived files, and 20 vector figure files

bounds.presentation_rounding: Six decimal places for losses and sample SD; source precision retained in bundled JSON.

non_claims: No statistical significance, causal mechanism, optimizer equivalence, non-inferiority, or universal batch-size scaling claim.
No fresh-seed confirmation of final selected recipes; selection procedures and tuning budgets differ.
No four-physical-GPU scaling or controlled speed benchmark; workers share one GH200.
No training, source-campaign mutation, configuration reselection, checkpoint creation, or grid extension.
No complete revalidation of every raw training metric; authenticated completed campaign audits supply that evidence.
Automated text page-bound checks and numeric coverage do not establish visual legibility or absence of overlapping content; root visual review is separate.

outcomes.pass: Finite numerical consistency and pinned evidence identity verified in this stated package; observed PDF counts are checked against the requested 13-slide and final 28-page artifacts.
outcomes.failure: An identity, numerical, eligibility, or presentation assertion is inconsistent; inspect the retained failure log before relying on the package.
outcomes.timeout_or_resource_limit: Inconclusive verification; no evidence of a scientific counterexample follows.
outcomes.inputs_changed: Reject the record as evidence for the originally pinned package until its changes are reconciled.

checks.check: process exited successfully within enforced limits
declared result files are present and regular

result: Run completed; mathematical assertion requires interpretation and review.
residual_risks: Command success does not establish the mathematical interpretation.
Only listed input artifacts are pinned; external dependencies need recorded versions.
The thread cap uses conventional environment variables; a child program may ignore them.
The POSIX CPU-time limit is per process, not an aggregate descendant budget.
